description: Add a dish/item to a menu (optionally inside a category). Returns the new item_id.

dietary_info.description: Allergen and dietary labels shown to diners. `allergens` uses the 14 standard codes (gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, peanuts, soybeans, milk, nuts, celery, mustard, sesame, sulphites, lupin, molluscs); `contains` flags alcohol, pork or tobacco; `suitableFor` carries positive claims (vegetarian, vegan, halal, ...); `caloriesKcal` and `portionGrams` are per portion. Optional `declaredAt` (epoch-ms) records that a dish was reviewed, which sharpens check_compliance — a dish with no allergens and no declaredAt is indistinguishable from one nobody has looked at yet.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id (8-64 chars). Reuse the same id when retrying so a retry can never create a duplicate.

price.description: Price in the business's currency. Required unless `variations` is given, in which case it is derived from the cheapest variation.

variations.description: Variations of this dish — sizes, volumes, portions, cuts — each with its own ABSOLUTE price (not a surcharge): e.g. [{name:'Small',price:3},{name:'Large',price:4.5}]. Use this instead of creating one item per variation. The item's own `price` becomes the 'from' price (the cheapest variation) automatically, so you may omit `price` when you pass variations. Names must be unique.
